title: 최종 commit/push와 재평가
summary: 최신 소스와 loop evidence를 깨끗한 feature/memecast-mvp branch 상태로 commit/push한 뒤 evaluator를 다시 실행한다.
deliverables: pushed feature/memecast-mvp branch or explicit push failure record
acceptance: Working tree contains no unrelated dirty or untracked project artifacts that are required for the MVP but left outside the commit.
Latest source, task graph, verification evidence, and context refresh are committed on feature/memecast-mvp with no secrets.
Push to origin/feature/memecast-mvp succeeds, or a concrete network/auth blocker is recorded before claiming anything less than complete.
Goal evaluator is rerun after the clean commit/push attempt and no longer reports dirty/unpushed, inconsistent evidence, or generator-first design failures.
Only after the evaluator passes may the loop emit COMPLETE.
modeContract: implementation: final state must be backed by repo state, checks, smoke evidence, and evaluator result.
designContract: Do not regress TASK-009 generator-first UI while preparing final commit/push.
evaluatorReason: Latest artifact is dirty/unpushed and must be cleaned before re-evaluation.
